title.narrative: Wondruba community leaders Peace and Reconciliation Conference.

description.narrative: This is a 6 month intra community reconciliation initiative aimed at promoting the well being and peaceful co-existence among the people of Wandruba in Juba County, Central Equatoria state. The project is part of SUD10-06 Pprogramme, "Strengthening peace, development and accountability through increased community dialogue, reconciliation and participation in the post referendum era in Southern Sudan, SUD10-06. Waduruba community has been under the Juba County administration since the colonial period, but during the 5th Sudan population and housing census some of the community leaders felt that they should be registered under Lainya County, where the vast majority of their Pojulu tribe originate from. The idea was not welcomed by some of the leaders and a section of the community who preferred to maintain the status quo, which has resulted into a rift between the community leading to loss of lives, property, and arrests especially of the youths with situation remaining tense ever since and taking a political dimension. In order to avert the current situation from turning more chaotic, the Central Equatoria State leadership formally requested RECONCILE and CAFOD to facilitate the reconciliation process and engage the warring parties to dialogue and resolve the their differences amicably to live in peace as before.
